error[ZBX-E0510]: the registry sent a type of document zbx does not read
  cause  the media type 'application/vnd.example.unknown.v9+json' is not one zbx
         reads
  fix    zbx reads OCI and Docker v2 images (tar, gzip, zstd)
  more   zbx explain E0510 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0510.html
